name: What is the difference between a standard water heater and a tankless water heater for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a standard water heater and a tankless water heater for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard water heater stores and heats a large volume of water in a tank, providing a limited amount of hot water at once. A tankless water heater heats water on demand as it flows through the unit, providing a continuous supply of hot water. Tankless units are generally more energy-efficient and save space, but have a higher upfront installation cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard water heaters store hot water in a tank; tankless heaters provide hot water on demand. Tankless are more energy-efficient and save space but cost more initially.
